brief: I Ran, 229.3-263.7 s of the song. Rafa sprints along a moonlit jungle gorge ledge; the cracked edge gives way under his boot and he falls backward into the misty gorge. The fall drifts slowly through fog, then he crashes down into a night jungle festival below. Lune, who has been dancing at the festival, finds him in the wreckage and pulls him up; their eyes meet. One continuous story, three planned Clips after the salvaged opening.

clips.title: Salvaged opening
clips.entry: Rafa sprinting toward camera along the ledge path
clips.exit: Boot breaks through the crumbling edge, body tipping back
clips.camera: Handheld, backing in front of him, then sinking to the boots

clips.title: The fall
clips.entry: Boot already through the edge, momentum carrying him backward
clips.exit: Face-up, arms spread, sinking into dense fog
clips.camera: Continuous: over the boot, along the body, then easing toward his face as the fall slows
clips.action: Continuous momentum: supporting ground gives way, body keeps travelling down and back, slow-motion during the 238-246 s hold, descent continues throughout.

clips.title: The landing
clips.entry: Rafa drops out of the fog above the festival
clips.exit: Rafa lying in torn canopy fabric and scattered light rigging, dazed
clips.camera: Wide from below as he drops out of the fog; one cut at about 3.9 s (the 250.06 s beat) to ground level as he lands

clips.title: The meeting
clips.entry: Lune pushes through the crowd toward the wreckage
clips.exit: Lune and Rafa face to face, her hand on his chest, eyes locked
clips.camera: Follows Lune in, settles on a two-shot
